verdict.rationale: Kommo's own marketing claims it can track ROI, lead quality, and sales performance natively, which touches the core of in-product reporting. There is no documentation of building custom reports or dashboards. The developer docs only list 'dashboard' as a place where widgets can be shown, which is a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented report/dashboard builder, pipeline and conversion-funnel reports, activity reporting, customization depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet

citations.quote: Track ROI, lead quality, and sales performance in every conversation.
